```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
#| cache: false
# ---- shared setup: attach every package here (cached chunks do not re-attach) ----
options(digits = 3, width = 90, mc.cores = 4, brms.backend = "cmdstanr")
set.seed(1234)

library(tidyverse)
library(tinytable)
library(hrbrthemes)
library(showtext)
library(posterior)
library(cmdstanr)
library(brms)
library(bayesplot)
library(marginaleffects)
library(nnet)
library(loo)
library(patchwork)
library(foreach)
library(doParallel)
library(modelsummary)
library(broom)
library(scales)

# fonts (same as the notes)
font_add_google("Source Sans 3", family = "Source Sans 3")
showtext_auto()
showtext_opts(dpi = 192)

# ---- deck theme: the ONLY ggplot styling helpers slides may use ----
# Source Sans 3 and the course's Set1 accents. The design agent may revise the
# bodies of these functions; the names and arguments are fixed.
lecture_colors <- c(red = "#e41a1c", blue = "#377eb8", green = "#4daf4a",
                    purple = "#984ea3", orange = "#ff7f00", gray = "#737b87")

# Sized for fig-width 10 at dpi 192 on a 1600 x 900 slide: base_size 18 prints
# near the slide's body text; axis titles quieter than the data.
theme_lecture <- function(base_size = 18) {
  ink <- "#1d232b"; soft <- "#4a5260"; grid <- "#e6e9ed"
  theme_ipsum(base_family = "Source Sans 3", base_size = base_size,
              plot_title_family = "Source Sans 3",
              plot_title_size = base_size * 1.2, plot_title_face = "bold",
              plot_title_margin = base_size * 0.5,
              subtitle_family = "Source Sans 3",
              subtitle_size = base_size * 0.95, subtitle_margin = base_size * 0.8,
              strip_text_family = "Source Sans 3",
              strip_text_size = base_size, strip_text_face = "bold",
              caption_family = "Source Sans 3", caption_size = base_size * 0.7,
              axis_text_size = base_size * 0.85,
              axis_title_family = "Source Sans 3",
              axis_title_size = base_size * 0.9, axis_title_face = "plain",
              axis_title_just = "rt",
              plot_margin = margin(8, 12, 8, 8),
              grid_col = grid, grid = "XY", axis_col = grid) +
    theme(text = element_text(color = ink),
          plot.title = element_text(color = ink),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(color = soft),
          axis.text = element_text(color = soft),
          axis.title = element_text(color = soft),
          strip.text = element_text(color = ink, hjust = 0),
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          legend.position = "top",
          legend.justification = "left",
          legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
          legend.box.spacing = unit(base_size * 0.4, "pt"),
          legend.text = element_text(size = base_size * 0.9, color = ink),
          legend.title = element_text(size = base_size * 0.9, color = soft),
          plot.title.position = "plot",
          plot.caption = element_text(color = soft),
          plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA))
}
theme_set(theme_lecture())

scale_color_lecture <- function(...) scale_color_manual(values = unname(lecture_colors), ...)
scale_fill_lecture  <- function(...) scale_fill_manual(values = unname(lecture_colors), ...)

# bayesplot in the same palette: a ramp of the course blue
bayesplot::color_scheme_set(c("#9fbfdf", "#7aa8d2", "#5592c6", "#377eb8", "#2b6595", "#1b2a41"))
bayesplot::bayesplot_theme_set(theme_lecture())
```
